project.title: Office 365 and Microsoft Azure Cloud Service Delivery Manager

parentsummary.deliverables: Provided governance, oversight, and advisory services for Brookfield Renewable Energy's Azure and Office 365 cloud environments during a complex MSP vendor consolidation, overseeing the SoftChoice support vendor's cloud architecture, governing the Azure AD and Office 365 access control posture, managing the Microsoft Intune mobile security program rollout, and maintaining day-to-day operational service continuity.
parentsummary.outcomes: Successfully governed cloud service continuity and vendor transition during a period of significant M&A-driven organizational change, delivering consistent KPI-measured performance, a secured Azure AD and O365 access posture, and a successfully rolled-out mobile security program via Microsoft Intune.

challenge.summary: Brookfield Renewable Energy was executing a live MSP vendor consolidation while maintaining operational continuity across a globally distributed renewable energy portfolio. The primary risk was maintaining governance over Azure AD and Office 365 access posture during a period when vendor accountability was divided and configurations were actively being transitioned between SoftChoice and the outgoing MSP.

deliverables: Governed cloud service delivery and provided architectural guidance across Azure and Office 365 environments
Directed and oversaw the SoftChoice vendor cloud architecture throughout the MSP consolidation
Established and enforced IT Security governance aligned to NIST controls (equivalent to ITSG) across the cloud environment
Governed the Azure AD and Office 365 access control posture during MSP vendor consolidation
Directed the Microsoft Intune mobile security program rollout, establishing device management governance across the Brookfield user population during the MSP transition
Coordinated transition requirements across Brookfield Renewable Energy business departments and SoftChoice support teams
Oversaw workload and workflow migration to Office365, and Azure Cloud
Responsible for performance monitoring via standardized KPIs
Provided knowledge transfer and training to internal FTE staff
Governed day-to-day IT operations and service requests — including Active Directory, on-premises email, and Cisco CUCM — maintaining continuity across the user base during the MSP vendor transition

outcomes: ✅ Maintained cloud service continuity and sustained KPI-measured performance throughout the SoftChoice MSP vendor transition, preventing disruption to Brookfield's globally distributed operations
✅ Secured Azure AD and Office 365 access posture during the MSP consolidation, governing access controls across a multi-country user base
✅ Successfully oversaw the rollout of the Microsoft Intune mobile security program, extending device management governance to the Brookfield user population
